title: Generic hex wargame: full CRT/TEC/ZOC/supply on NATO-symbol counters
description:
A reference hex-and-counter wargame implementing the full suite of classic wargame mechanics. Not based on any specific commercial game — a generic demonstration of the form, like what a wargame design textbook would use as its running example.

**Map:**
- 20x15 hex grid with mixed terrain: clear, forest, hills, mountains, river (hex-side), road, town, bridge
- Terrain Effects Chart (TEC) as cell properties: movement cost, defense modifier, LOS blocking

**Counters (NATO MIL-STD-2525 style):**
- ~20 units per side (2 players: blue/red)
- Unit types: infantry, armor, artillery, mechanized infantry, headquarters
- Counter values: attack strength, defense strength, movement points
- Unit properties: unit_type, formation, step_losses (multi-step units)

**Turn structure:**
- IGOUGO (I Go, You Go): active player does all phases, then opponent
- Phases per turn: reinforcement, movement, combat, exploitation (armor breakthrough), supply check

**Movement:**
- Terrain movement costs from TEC
- Road movement bonus (half cost along road hexes)
- Zone of Control: entering enemy ZOC costs all remaining MP, must stop
- ZOC-to-ZOC movement prohibited (no sliding between enemy units)
- Stacking limit: 3 units per hex

**Combat:**
- Mandatory attack against adjacent enemy units
- Odds ratio: total attack strength / total defense strength → column on CRT
- Terrain defense modifier shifts odds
- Die roll (d6) cross-referenced on CRT
- Results: DE (defender eliminated), DR (defender retreat 1-2 hexes), EX (exchange — both lose), AR (attacker retreat), NE (no effect)
- Retreat through enemy ZOC causes additional step loss
- Advance after combat into vacated hex

**Supply:**
- Each unit must trace supply line (path of hexes, max length ~10) to friendly map edge or HQ
- Out-of-supply: halved attack, no advance after combat, attrition losses if still out-of-supply next turn

**Victory conditions:**
- Control of objective hexes (towns marked as objectives)
- Eliminate enemy units (VP per unit destroyed)
- Time limit: fixed number of turns, highest VP wins

**Authority:**
- server_only: die rolls for CRT
- client_verifiable: movement (path cost calculation), attack declaration, retreat paths
- wasm_required (Felt): CRT lookup, supply line tracing, ZOC computation, odds calculation

**What this proves for Baize:**
- Hex grid with cell properties (terrain) at scale
- Stacking (3 units per hex)
- Multi-phase turns with distinct action types per phase
- Combat resolution via table lookup (Felt extension)
- Supply line pathfinding (Felt extension with flood_fill)
- Zone of control as movement constraint
- Component properties (attack/defense/movement) driving game logic
- NATO-style counter rendering (client SVG work, future)

Blocked by: baize-5hux (stacking), baize-6fm9 (wargame primitives/Felt)
close_reason: Full reference hex wargame: 20x15 grid, 300 cells (8 terrain types, river/bridges), 20 units/side (6 types), 5 phases (reinforcement/movement/combat/exploitation/supply), 12 rules, Felt extensions (terrain/CRT/ZOC/supply), 98 Python tests. Validates against schema.
